title: 6 March 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
Although The Beatles had previously played three lunchtime shows at Liverpool’s Cavern Club, performances at the venue were not regular. However, this day was the beginning of a week of lunchtime sessions held at the club.

The Beatles were the act making the most appearances in the week, performing on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. The Big Three played on Tuesday and Derry And The Seniors made an appearance on Thursday.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1972: John Lennon and Yoko Ono receive US deportation notice
  • 1970: Mixing: Sentimental Journey by Ringo Starr
  • 1970: Recording: You Always Hurt The One You Love by Ringo Starr
  • 1970: UK single release: Let It Be
  • 1967: Recording, mixing: Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band
  • 1966: Paul McCartney and Jane Asher holiday in Switzerland
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas

  • 1963: Radio: Here We Go
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
